arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Jaicomo argued that Congress amended the Act in 1974 to ensure a legal remedy for intentional torts.
Mr. Mills argued that the FTCA does not make the United States liable for lawful acts of its agents.
Mr. Liu noted that the Court granted certiorari on two questions regarding the proviso and the Supremacy Clause.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: the sides that brought the case want the Court to hold that the proviso creates a freestanding rule allowing claims for lawful acts.
The United States wants the Court to hold that the Act does not waive immunity for lawful acts of agents.
